notes.title: Astro Attack Steam Deck Support
notes.content:
Astro Attack fully supports and is optimized for the Steam Deck!

Take the arcade action with you and unlock all kinds of ships from the comfort of your very own bathroom!

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.2
notes.content:
Another quick fix! There was an issue with the Dragicorn achievement, which should be completable now (it is very cute ship). 

Thanks again to everyone for the feedback! Keep it coming.

Pew pew pew!

James

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.1
notes.content:
I've just pushed out a few small fixes. Thanks so much to everyone for all the support so far! It's so exciting seeing people jumping in and giving Astro Attack a go.

Changed:
- Fixed an issue with Secret Hunter being awarded to everyone. The achievement has been fixed and progress has been reset
- Fixed a few issues with screen loads not respecting fade outs
- Fixed an issue with the Secret Unlocked screen not working correctly

Please keep any issues and feedback coming! And if you're enjoying the game, leaving a kind review really helps letting more people know about the game

Pew pew pew!

James
